title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
description:
Waze is introducing new AI-powered features to improve navigation and traffic updates. The company is using machine learning to analyze traffic patterns and provide more accurate route suggestions, which will help Waze users avoid congested roads and reduce travel time.
Story source: https://www.theverge.com/transportation/964132/waze-gemini-ai-voice-commands-less-chatty
